verdict.rationale: Reclaim's own Calendar Sync copies events from source calendars onto a destination calendar, so bookings and auto-scheduling respect your true availability across multiple calendars. It works with Google and Outlook. Apple/iCloud is only reachable indirectly, by syncing a shared iCloud calendar into a Google Calendar, and a community user reported Reclaim required Google Calendar and lacked CalDAV support. missing for 10: native Apple/iCloud (CalDAV) calendar connection, explicit documentation of mixed Google+Outlook conflict checking, independent hands-on confirmation that double-booking is prevented across all connected calendars.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, I can connect several calendars (Google, Outlook, Apple) and every one is checked for conflicts so I never get double-booked

citations.quote: Calendar Sync takes events from a source calendar - we call these source events - and creates smart copies of them on a destination calendar - we call these synced copies.
Reclaim's Calendar Sync feature is a powerful way to make sure people who go to book time with you always see your true availability across multiple calendars.
Automatically defend time for events across all of your schedules.
you can use a shared calendar (via iCloud, or another external calendar service) and sync events from that calendar to another Google Calendar using our Calendar Sync feature.
Reclaim is designed to be a calendar assistant that works with your Google or Outlook calendar (not replace it).
